default.description: Least-privilege capability for the ZCrypt wallet's single trusted window. Node and BTC RPC and file writes go through explicit Rust commands, so only the core defaults are granted here: no shell, fs or http plugin access reaches the webview. Phone-only plugin permissions live in mobile.json.

mobile.description: Phone-only additions: the camera QR scanner the Send tab uses to read an address. The biometric prompt is raised from Rust and needs no webview permission.
